full_details: The afternoon was Errors, and you opened it. The middle of the play did not need you. You did not bring a sum home from the door. At supper she had heard you walking, quick and stopping. Two great houses, alike in everything, a quarrel so old nobody knows the cause, servants in the street, and the Prince promising death for the next. She said he was the only man in it with sense, and supposed he was not the chief part. You told her you are to play him. She told you to speak up. The loaf went against the notch and wanted a full thumb. She said that by Michaelmas you would be eating the board. The penny did not change. Verbeke showed a weaver's knot on a length of thrum and had you tie it four times. The words were draad, spoel, knoop. Thread, shuttle, knot. Alse tied it at the first try and was told not to look pleased. Under Words you wrote the thrum, the knot, and that he says the shuttle sings.
one_sentence: You played Egeon and then waited, and at her table the loaf was a thumb short and the knot took four tries.
title: Egeon, a short loaf, and a knot
